Convert AR coefficient signs between supported conventions

Source: R/03-parameters.R
convert_sign_convention.Rd

Change the signs of a coefficient vector when moving between the Deltares recurrence and the alternative signed equation convention.

Usage

convert_sign_convention(
  coefficients,
  from = c("Deltares", "Standard"),
  to = c("Deltares", "Standard")
)

Arguments

coefficients

Numeric vector ordered from first to highest lag.

from

Convention currently used by coefficients.

to

Convention required in the returned vector.

Value

A numeric vector in the requested convention. Coefficient order and names are preserved.

Examples

convert_sign_convention(
  coefficients = c(1.765, -0.72625, -0.040656),
  from = "Deltares",
  to = "Standard"
)
#> [1] -1.765000  0.726250  0.040656
